text.en: This is the Secondary Education Examination (SEE) 2081 (2025 AD) question paper for Computer Science, Optional Second subject, paper code RE-3031. items.code:
DECLARE SUB Display (T$)
T$="COMPUTER"
CALL Display (T$)
END

SUB Display (T$)
  FOR C=1 TO LEN (T$) STEP 2
    D$=MID$ (T$,C,1)
    PRINT D$;
  NEXT C
END SUB

items.code:
DECLARE FUNCTION COUNT (A$)
CLS
INPUT "Enter any word";W$
END

FUNCTION COUNT (A$)
  B=LEN(A$)
  C=0
FOR i=1 TO B
  E$=MID$(C$,i,1)
  IF E$="A" OR E$="E" OR E$="I" OR E$="O" OR E$="U" THEN
  C=C+1
  END IF
NEXT i
COUNT=C
END FUNCTION
items.ocrFlag: The printed line 'E$=MID$(C$,i,1)' uses C$, which is not declared anywhere (the function parameter is A$). This looks like an OCR/print error for A$; preserved here exactly as scanned rather than silently corrected - please check the original paper. See the answers file for the suggested correction.
